title: Official SAM.gov Notices Supporting the Award Patterns

records.title: TECOM Range and Training Area Management Support Services
records.set_aside: Competitive small business set-aside stated in notice
records.official_scope_summary: The notice states that the follow-on scope includes range safety, range certification, RFMSS, RMTK, GIS data maintenance and development, curriculum work, range training systems, and installation-level range operations support.

records.title: USMC Range Control Facilities
records.official_scope_summary: The solicitation states that the services provide operational, safety, technical, and administrative support to Range Control Facilities. Public attachments include an RFMSS user manual and range-control task materials.

records.title: Request for Information - National Geospatial Services
records.period_structure: Five years, described as a base year plus four one-year options
records.official_scope_summary: The notice describes professional geospatial services including GIS, GPS, remote sensing, helpdesk support, operational support, analysis, and geospatial data and product delivery.
